documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Notice Of 4Th Annual General Meeting Of The Members Of OCCL Limited

analysis.summary: OCCL reported Q3 FY26 financial results with total income of INR114.6 crores and EBITDA of INR20.2 crores. Management noted that while automobile demand and domestic capacity utilization are resilient, high sulphur prices continue to impact margins, and anti-dumping duty benefits have been offset by aggressive pricing from Chinese competitors. The company is actively focusing on increasing its domestic market share and anticipates potential normalization of US export tariffs and raw material costs over time. During Q3 FY26, OCCL reported revenue of approximately Rs. 115 crores, accompanied by a 26% growth in EBITDA to Rs.

guidance.claim: The Indian tyre industry is expected to grow by 7% to 8% in FY 26.
guidance.quote: The Indian tyre industry is expected to grow by 7% to 8% in FY '26.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates an annual global demand increase of 2% to 3%.
guidance.quote: We are expecting a 2% to 3% growth in demand annually.

demand_outlook.claim: Calendar year 2025 witnessed strong growth in automobile sales driven by multiple positive factors such as reduction of GST, income tax reductions, and a more accommodative monetary policy.
demand_outlook.quote: Calendar year 2025 witnessed strong growth in automobile sales driven by multiple positive factors such as reduction of GST, income tax reductions, and a more accommodative monetary policy.

demand_outlook.claim: The India-EU Free Trade Agreement is expected to add comfort and support a cautiously positive medium-term export outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: The India–EU Free Trade Agreement shall add comfort and support a cautiously positive medium-term export outlook.

demand_outlook.claim: The recent trade deal with the USA is expected to lower tariffs and support better realisation in the region going forward.
demand_outlook.quote: The recent trade deal with the USA is expected to lower tariffs and support better realsiation in the region going forward.

demand_outlook.claim: Higher demand for cars, two-wheelers, and commercial vehicles should lead to increased tyre production, boosting insoluble sulphur demand in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Higher demand for cars, two-wheelers, and commercial vehicles should lead to increased tyre production, which in turn will boost demand for insoluble Sulphur in India.

demand_outlook.claim: Following the imposition of anti-dumping duties on imports from Japan and China, the company witnessed some improvement in domestic insoluble sulphur realisations.
demand_outlook.quote: In the domestic market, following the imposition of anti-dumping duties on imports from Japan and China, the Company has witnessed some improvement in domestic insoluble sulphur realisations.

demand_outlook.claim: The insoluble sulphur market remains stable, but global realizations stay under pressure due to oversupply.
demand_outlook.quote: The insoluble sulphur market continues to be stable. However, global realizations remain under pressure due to oversupply.

demand_outlook.claim: The long-term industry outlook is supported by structural growth in the global tyre sector and demand for environmental-compliant products.
demand_outlook.quote: The long-term outlook for the industry remains strong, supported by structural growth in the global tyre sector and increasing demand for high-performance environmental compliant products.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian tyre industry shows healthy momentum with robust demand from OEM and replacement segments post-radialization.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian tyre industry continues to demonstrate healthy momentum supported by robust demand from both OEM and replacement segments especially post-radialization.

margins_costs.claim: All-time high prices of sulphur are affecting company margins.
margins_costs.quote: Though all-time high prices of Sulphur are affecting our margins, we expect either the Sulphur prices to come down or our competition and us to pass on these increasing raw material prices to our customers.

margins_costs.claim: When the American tariff was increased, deep discounts had to be given to maintain supply to America, which affected margins.
margins_costs.quote: When the American tariff was increased, we had to give deep discounts to maintain our supply to America, which affected our margins.

margins_costs.claim: The anti-dumping duty impact has kept margins intact despite sulphur prices going up.
margins_costs.quote: Yeah, so basically I would say that the ADD impact has kept our margins intact in spite of insoluble -- in spite of sulphur prices going up.

margins_costs.claim: High sulphur prices which impact margins remain a challenge.
margins_costs.quote: Though high sulphur prices which impacts margin remain a challenge.

margins_costs.claim: The imposition of anti-dumping duties on China and Japan improved domestic realizations, but the impact was muted by higher raw material prices.
margins_costs.quote: The imposition of anti-dumping duties on China and Japan has improved our domestic realizations. However, the impact is muted by increase in raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: Benchmark sulphur costs have seen a steady uptrend due to tight supply and stronger demand, pressuring input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Over the past few months, benchmark sulphur costs have seen a steady uptrend, driven by tight supply and stronger demand, putting pressure on input costs across the industry.

margins_costs.claim: Total income for Q2 FY26 was Rs. 121 crores with EBITDA of Rs. 20 crores and an EBITDA margin of 16.8%.
margins_costs.quote: Total income for Q2 FY26 stood at Rs.121 crores, compared to Rs.104 crores in Q2 FY25, a growth of 16%. EBITDA for Q2 FY26 stood at Rs.20 crores, against Rs.19 crores in Q2 FY25, a 5% year-on-year growth. The EBITDA margins were 16.8%.

margins_costs.claim: Total income for H1 FY26 was Rs. 244 crores with EBITDA at Rs. 47 crores and EBITDA margins at 19.2%.
margins_costs.quote: Total income for H1 FY26 stood at Rs.244 crores, EBITDA Rs.47 crores, EBITDA margins 19.2%.

margins_costs.claim: The increase in cost of sulphur alone on insoluble sulphur was more than Rs. 10,000 per tonne for the quarter ended September 2025 versus September 2024.
margins_costs.quote: the increase merely on account of cost of sulphur for quarter ended September 2025 versus quarter ended September 2024 is more than Rs. 10,000 per tonne.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization levels around the world are between 70% to 75%.
orders_capacity.quote: See, the current capacity utilization levels around the world are between 70% to 75% as per our reckoning.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's capacity utilization is around 70%.
orders_capacity.quote: So the capacity utilization is around 70%.

orders_capacity.claim: The annual installed capacity for insoluble sulphur is 17,500 MT at Dharuhera and 22,000 MT at SEZ Mundra.
orders_capacity.quote:
Insoluble Sulphur 17,500 Dharuhera (Haryana) 3 
 Insoluble Sulphur 22,000 SEZ Mundra (Gujarat) 4

orders_capacity.claim: The annual capacity for sulphuric acid and oleum is 88,000 MT at Dharuhera.
Insoluble sulphur capacity utilization was roughly 70% and sulphuric acid was at full capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Insoluble sulphur is roughly 70% and sulphuric acid is full capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: There are currently no plans for a share buyback.
capital_allocation.quote: No, there are currently no plans for share buyback as of now.

capital_allocation.claim: Total debt position as of September 2025 stood at Rs. 81 crores, with long-term debt of Rs. 26.5 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Total debt position as on September 2025 stood at Rs.81 crores, with long-term debt of Rs.26.5 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: The fact that the Chinese did not increase prices despite rising raw material prices took away the whole benefit of the anti-dumping duty.
risks_headwinds.quote: The fact that the Chinese did not increase the price even though raw material prices have increased, have taken away the whole benefit of the anti-dumping duty.

risks_headwinds.claim: High sulphur prices impacting margins remain a challenge.
risks_headwinds.quote: Though high sulphur prices which impacts margin remain a challenge.

risks_headwinds.claim: The US imposition of a 50% tariff on imports from India impacted margins for the supplied quantity.
risks_headwinds.quote: The recent move by the United States to impose a 50% tariff on imports from India has also impacted our margins to the effect of the quantity that we are supplying there.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
